SECTION C: (3 Marks Each)

Q31. A game consists of tossing a one-rupee coin 3 times. Hanif wins if all tosses are the same (HHH or TTT) and loses otherwise. Find the probability that Hanif will lose.

Answer / Solution:
Total outcomes for 3 tosses = 2^3 = 8
Winning outcomes: HHH, TTT => 2
Losing outcomes = 8 - 2 = 6
Probability of losing = 6/8 = 3/4
Answer: 3/4
